versions.changelog: v1.0.8 - brand promo link updated to https://www.xiaoyaosai.com/ (docs-only change: SKILL.md bilingual promo line; no behavior change).
Docs only: replaced the XiaoyaoClaw promo line in SKILL.md with a bilingual XiaoyaoAI promo block (Chinese + English, project.xiaoyaosai.com). No functional, script, or metadata changes.

v1.0.6 narrows the read scope, addressing the last ClawScan note that the skill asked to read the whole OpenClaw configuration: reads are now explicitly limited to window-related fields (model ids, contextWindow, maxTokens, and the agents' model / imageModel / pdfModel references); credential-bearing or unrelated configuration sections (API keys, channel settings, tool and plugin config) are never read out, shown in the conversation, or forwarded; if a full-config response is returned by the gateway tool, only the window fields are extracted and the rest is not echoed; if credential-like content appears incidentally it is ignored and not written anywhere. skill-card.md gained a matching risk/mitigation entry, and both READMEs document the scoped read. No functional change to writes: window field only, shown as an old-to-new diff, confirmed before writing.

v1.0.5 addresses every remaining ClawScan item on activation scope and package consistency: (1) added skill-card.md with description, use case and known risks/mitigations (fixes verify card.missing); (2) removed the two design documents that repeatedly conflicted with SKILL.md (interaction + trigger design notes now live outside the published package); (3) removed the optional periodic/event-trigger sections from both READMEs, so nothing in the package suggests the skill schedules or starts anything; (4) trigger surface reduced to three explicit phrases, with an explicit statement that generic context/memory/token talk will not activate it and that it never starts on its own; (5) execution step 3 now requires showing an old-to-new full-field diff and a second confirmation before writing, and values whose source is unofficial or unreachable are marked untraced and never written. Package: SKILL.md, skill-card.md, README.md/en, docs/DESIGN.md, PROGRESS.md, LICENSE, assets. No functional change: window field only, confirmation required, nothing written to disk.

v1.0.4 removes the last documentation contradictions found by ClawScan: (1) historical design drafts (which described the earlier automatic behaviour) are no longer part of the package - the shipped docs now speak with one voice; (2) the rollback path no longer references exec or temp files: it is an in-session record only, with the reverse patch generated in-session and nothing written to disk; (3) the interaction doc no longer implies the skill initiates anything by itself - the optional periodic check is purely user-configured; (4) progress notes no longer contain machine-specific enablement detail. Package is now 11 files: SKILL.md, README.md/en, PROGRESS.md, docs/{DESIGN,INTERACTION,TRIGGERS}.md, assets, LICENSE. No functional change.

v1.0.3 removes the remaining ClawScan concerns: (1) rollback wording no longer contradicts the no-local-files promise - it is now 'undo THIS adjustment', explicitly valid only within the same session since nothing is written to disk; (2) all automation wording removed - the flow is stated as read-only detect, one-digit decide, apply-after-confirmation, and the skill is documented as never running on its own (no scheduled jobs, no background behavior); the optional periodic check is clearly labelled as user-configured; (3) trigger surface narrowed to an explicit intent list, with an instruction not to activate on generic talk about context, memory or token usage. No functional change: window-field-only writes, confirmation required, nothing written to disk.

v1.0.2 resolves the remaining ClawScan item (self-contradiction between 'writes no files' and session-storage edits): removed the session-storage edit capability entirely - the skill never modifies session storage and creates no backup files; step 5 is now a no-op that only explains stale display; the never-writes row is now precise (no config keys beyond the window field, no scheduled jobs, no local files including backups or audit files); rollback record is explicitly kept in-session only (nothing written to disk); README zh/en, DESIGN and INTERACTION synced; historical EVAL record moved to docs/archive.

v1.0.1 security-scope tightening after ClawScan review: added explicit Permissions and Write-Operations section (reads / single writable field / never-writes / network-read-only / reload / session state / rollback record / failure handling); execution steps 4-5 narrowed (runtime reload is suggest-only and never executed unattended; session state is untouched by default, and if requested is limited to the current session contextTokens field with backup and explicit confirmation); added read/write trigger tiering so plain 'context check' is read-only and every write requires decision-card confirmation; unified no-trail wording; removed all XML comments from hero.svg; README zh/en updated (transparent writes, network reads only, no automation baked in).

Initial release: context check / context optimization - detect enabled models, fetch vendor-spec context length, propose 60 percent window, apply after one-digit confirmation. Pure instruction skill: no scripts, no data files, no dependencies. Includes decide-then-apply flow, rollback, and no-history policy.
